messages:
marta: quick alert  LCP up ~350ms on /dashboard EU canary after the telemetry-proxy deploy. traces point to main-thread parse. replay: https://replay.internal/ghi789 :grimace:
kevin: looking - big parse blob from a new chunk + kv-cache miss spikes. metrics pane bundle + gz ~100kb bump
sam: repro'd locally. `viz-serializer` is imported at module top for export simplicity; prefetch makes it parse during nav
olivia: that serializer was sync to keep export fast. didn't realize the prefetch policy would cause eager parse on unrelated navs
marta: telemetry shows a kvcache-prefix miss surge at same times. we changed metric-id prefix last week; maybe current keys don't match new lookup path so we fallback and rehydrate heavy payloads
kevin: two fold: (A) prefetch policy loads top-level chunks aggressively, (B) infra counts prefetches against route quotas so background prefetches can trigger throttling and delay fetches. delayed fetch + parse collision = LCP bump
sam: short fix: make serializer dynamic and gate prefetch on heuristics (chartsVisible/device). quick sketch: ```if (chartsVisible>2 && !isLowEndDevice()) prefetch('/chunks/viz-serializer.js',{purpose:'prefetch'})```
kevin: add header X-Purpose: prefetch so infra can ignore for quota math. also have infra add a server-side exclusion for client-generated prefetches
olivia: I'll switch to dynamic import + split out a tiny csv-only serializer. will mark webpackChunkName to preserve split. PR forthcoming
marta: can we rollback telemetry-proxy canary while we stabilize? @deploy-bot rollback to previous sha please
deploy-bot: received rollback request from marta. initiating rollback of canary-proxy -> sha abc123. est ~3m :hourglass:
sam: opening PR with conditional prefetch, prefetch header, and telemetry events (prefetch.requested, prefetch.blocked) and kvcache.lookup.variant for schema insight
kevin: please also surface prefetch latency buckets and quota-metadata in telemetry. I'll coordinate infra to prototype ignoring X-Purpose: prefetch
nolivia: PR: https://github.com/redwood/viz/pull/471 - adds dynamic import, chunkName, trimmed serializer build, and prefetch gating. left old flow behind a flag for rollback speed
marta: rollback reduced median LCP by ~350ms in canary. good signal. let's run a 10% EU canary with Olivia's change and gate for 48h before full promotion. alert if median LCP > baseline+200ms
kevin: also alert on kvcache miss-rate increase. will file infra ticket to treat prefetch X-Purpose differently
sam: will add canary manifest + alert rule in PR description. monitoring 24h and will post results
olivia: adding CI parse-time test for the trimmed serializer to prevent future regressions
marta: follow-ups: (1) telemetry key migration doc (sam), (2) infra quota-exclude for prefetch (kevin), (3) release small serializer + CI (olivia). I'll create tickets after this thread
deploy-bot: rollback complete -> sha abc123. monitoring metrics for 30m
